summary: Phase-3 (Fast2SMS OTP fallback, admin integrations config, Razorpay dev-mock payments, Google login gating, Profile editor) tested end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_integrations_phase3.py (26 tests) and fixed 2 stale tests in test_erp_admin.py; full suite 174/174 pass against the public preview URL. Frontend: verified login page (email form, WhatsApp/Google fallback + hint toast, demo logins), non-demo dev-OTP login end-to-end, Profile Editor (all fields + admin gating + save + base64 photo upload/persistence), Wallet dev-mock top-up (balance 6050 -> 6350 + txn), booking Pay via /payments/order+/payments/mock (booking flipped Completed -> Paid). One CRITICAL admin UI bug found: Integrations/API text inputs lose focus after every keystroke, so the owner cannot type API keys - this defeats the whole purpose of this phase.

critical.issue: Any authenticated user can credit their own wallet with an arbitrary amount (<=100000) with NO payment/gateway/admin check. Free-money hole that completely bypasses the new Razorpay/dev-mock payment flow (/api/payments/*). Should be admin-only or routed through payments.

Gateway-configured detection is done by actually calling razorpay create_order(1,'probe'). Once live keys are pasted this creates real junk Rs.1 orders in the owner's Razorpay account on every mock attempt. Detect configuration from settings instead of creating an order.

minor.issue: Marks the booking paid and inserts a wallet DEBIT transaction of the booking total but never decrements users.wallet_balance -> wallet balance and transaction ledger do not reconcile (UI shows -Rs.624.2 'Payment' rows while balance is unchanged). Gateway payments should not create wallet debit txns (or must also debit).

Returns 400 'Payment allowed only after service completion' instead of 'Already paid' because status flips to 'paid' and the completed-check runs before the paid-check in _booking_for_pay. Misleading message.
Legacy payment endpoint still marks a booking paid without any gateway/mock interaction, duplicating /api/payments/*. Should be removed or delegated to payment_controller to keep one payment path.

admin_controller.update_settings writes the whole payload into audit_logs.detail as plain text, so Fast2SMS API keys / Razorpay secrets / Google client secret are stored in cleartext in audit logs. Mask secret keys before logging.
No server-side size limit on the base64 'photo' field (frontend-only 2MB guard); a direct API call can push a multi-MB document into Mongo.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: every text field loses focus after the first character. Typing 'ABCDEFGH' into the Fast2SMS API key left only 'A' (verified, value persisted as 'A' after save+reload). Root cause: `Txt` and `Tog` are components DECLARED INSIDE the render body (lines 432-433), so a new component type is created on each state change and React unmounts/remounts the input on every keystroke. Owner literally cannot type Fast2SMS/Razorpay/Google credentials. Fix: hoist Txt/Tog outside the component (memoized, receiving value+onChange), or inline the JSX/map like CommissionSettings does.
Secret fields (Fast2SMS API key, Razorpay test/live key secrets, Google client secret) render as plain text inputs (type attribute absent). Use type="password" / masked reveal toggle.

send() unconditionally toasts `OTP sent · Dev OTP: ${data.dev_otp}` and autofills the OTP box. When Fast2SMS is enabled with a valid key the backend returns no dev_otp, so users will see 'Dev OTP: undefined'. Branch on data.dev_otp and fall back to data.message.
has no onError fallback; an invalid/truncated data URL renders the browser broken-image icon instead of the UserIcon placeholder (reproduced).

integration_issues.issue: Works (order->mock->status Paid), but the customer's wallet balance card is unchanged while a -Rs.624.2 'Payment' transaction appears in the wallet ledger, so balance vs. transactions are inconsistent to the user.

issues: Date of Birth uses the native browser date picker (<input type="date">) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere
Gender / Language / Communication Preference use raw native <select> elements instead of the shadcn Select component - inconsistent height, font and caret vs. the rest of the app
No 'Test connection' action for Fast2SMS / Razorpay / Google, so the owner has no way to validate pasted keys

CRITICAL: lock down POST /api/wallet/topup (admin-only or route through /api/payments) - currently free wallet credit for any logged-in user

Reorder _booking_for_pay checks so an already-paid booking returns 'Already paid'

Do not persist integration secrets in audit_logs.detail; mask *key*/*secret* values
Fix booking-payment wallet ledger: either debit wallet_balance or don't insert a wallet debit txn for gateway payments
OtpLogin: only show the 'Dev OTP' hint when the response actually contains dev_otp
Mask secret inputs (type=password) and add onError fallback for the profile avatar image
Replace native date input / native selects in ProfileEditor with shadcn Calendar + Select

rca_of_the_issue: Admin Integrations focus loss: IntegrationsSettings re-declares the `Txt` (and `Tog`) function components on every render; React compares element types by identity, so each parent state update (triggered by onChange) produces a brand-new component type and React unmounts the old <input> and mounts a new one, destroying DOM focus. Result: only the first typed character survives per click. Reproduction: login as admin (+919000000000 / 123456) -> Integrations/API -> click Fast2SMS API Key -> type 'ABCDEFGH' -> field contains 'A'. Mitigation: define Txt/Tog at module scope (or use useCallback-free plain JSX) and pass value/onChange as props.
